query:
insert into public.service_areas (title, description, accent, icon, sort_order) values ('ROS, SLAM & Robot Simulation', 'Simulation-first robotics support for reproducible testing, integration, and prototype autonomy.', 'blue', 'robotics', 1), ('Embedded Systems & IoT', 'Connected-device engineering from firmware foundations to reliable communication interfaces.', 'teal', 'embedded', 2), ('Mechanical Design & CAD', 'Manufacturing-aware 3D modelling for components, enclosures, and machine assemblies.', 'orange', 'mechanical', 3), ('Engineering Consulting & Documentation', 'Focused engineering review that turns technical uncertainty into practical next steps.', 'ink', 'consulting', 4), ('AI & Computer Vision', 'Applied perception workflows that move from client data to deployable technical artefacts.', 'violet', 'vision', 5), ('Control, Simulation & Industrial Systems', 'Model-based control and end-to-end IoT prototypes designed around measurable system behavior.', 'green', 'control', 6);
insert into public.services (area_id, title, summary, deliverables, sort_order) values ((select id from public.service_areas where title = 'ROS, SLAM & Robot Simulation'), 'ROS / ROS 2 Robotics Simulation & Development', 'Develop ROS or ROS 2 robot simulations in Gazebo or Webots, including URDF models, virtual sensors, Python or C++ behavior nodes, and custom test environments.', array['Source code', 'Setup instructions', 'Reproducible run commands'], 1), ((select id from public.service_areas where title = 'ROS, SLAM & Robot Simulation'), 'UAV Simulation in ROS–Gazebo', 'Integrate a UAV model into a realistic simulation environment and evaluate multiple flight scenarios before physical testing.', array['Simulation workspace', 'Scenario definitions', 'Test summary'], 2), ((select id from public.service_areas where title = 'ROS, SLAM & Robot Simulation'), 'CAD-to-URDF Robot Models', 'Convert SolidWorks CAD assemblies into simulation-ready URDF packages with joints, collision geometry, Gazebo components, and inertial-property tuning.', array['URDF package', 'Simulator configuration', 'Integration notes'], 3), ((select id from public.service_areas where title = 'ROS, SLAM & Robot Simulation'), 'AI-Assisted Navigation & Obstacle Avoidance', 'Develop prototype AI or machine-learning modules that support navigation, autonomy, and obstacle avoidance in ROS-based systems.', array['Integration-ready modules', 'Evaluation scenarios', 'Technical documentation'], 4), ((select id from public.service_areas where title = 'Embedded Systems & IoT'), 'Embedded Firmware for Connected Devices', 'Develop firmware for STM32, ESP32, Arduino, or Raspberry Pi projects, including Wi-Fi, BLE, and MQTT communication.', array['Documented source code', 'Connection guidance', 'Build instructions'], 1), ((select id from public.service_areas where title = 'Embedded Systems & IoT'), 'PCB Design & Communication Interfaces', 'Create PCB designs in Altium, KiCad, or EasyEDA and develop reusable interfaces for I²C, SPI, CAN, Modbus, or LoRa.', array['Gerber files', 'Interface libraries', 'Manufacturing package'], 2), ((select id from public.service_areas where title = 'Mechanical Design & CAD'), '3D CAD & Machine-Part Design', 'Model precise mechanical parts, enclosures, and machine components in SolidWorks or Fusion 360 from client drawings or requirements.', array['Editable CAD files', 'STEP exports', 'Prototype-ready geometry'], 1), ((select id from public.service_areas where title = 'Engineering Consulting & Documentation'), 'Mechatronics Design Review & Technical Consulting', 'Review system concepts, technical drawings, and prototype architectures for robotics and mechatronics projects through a written report or remote consultation.', array['Technical recommendations', 'Review report', 'Scope discussion'], 1), ((select id from public.service_areas where title = 'Engineering Consulting & Documentation'), 'Robotics Research & Technical Review', 'Provide structured technical and methodological review for robotics and autonomous-systems research materials, including system design and experimental setup.', array['Structured feedback', 'Methodology notes', 'Documentation review'], 2), ((select id from public.service_areas where title = 'AI & Computer Vision'), 'Custom Object Detection & Vision Pipelines', 'Train custom YOLO object-detection models and build OpenCV image or video-processing pipelines around client data.', array['Trained weights', 'Evaluation results', 'Integration-ready code'], 1), ((select id from public.service_areas where title = 'AI & Computer Vision'), 'On-Device Local LLM Integration', 'Prepare compact local language-model deployments that operate without an internet connection on suitable embedded or edge hardware.', array['Deployment package', 'Runtime setup', 'Device instructions'], 2), ((select id from public.service_areas where title = 'Control, Simulation & Industrial Systems'),
